summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of its own ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between July 13–17, 2026. It bought 1,738,485 shares at a volume-weighted average price of roughly £10.53 per share, with the lowest price at £10.35 and the highest at £10.745. The repurchases were conducted through JP Morgan Securities plc under a buyback authority from the 2025 AGM. The company intends to cancel all repurchased shares, reducing its share count. Since the program began on 6 Jan 2026, it has repurchased 47,388,392 shares at a VWAP of 1,092.12p. This is a routine share buyback program executed as an on-market purchase, not a special-situation capital return announcement; the filing simply provides periodic disclosure of open-market buybacks.
